<!-- pr-reviewer: 40ba968869c783cb6838af56d78db31a7b30df20 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- No new dependency and no `preserve_order` workspace-wide, so project files and other JSON writers are untouched. No `build.rs`, scripts or `.github` changes.
- `order.rs` has provenance, is 160 lines, and has no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic`. Serializer failures fall back to safe text. Array indexing uses `.get(i)`.
- Unreadable text gives an empty `KeyOrder`, so output falls back to sorted. A duplicate key keeps its first place and last value, as `serde_json::Value` does.
- Edits still act on the plain `Value`, so `fields.rs` is unchanged. Every save path goes through `MachineDraft::text()`.
- The two tests pin both ends: order preserved with new keys last, and a byte-identical match to `to_pretty` when no order is recorded.
- Decision recorded in `docs/decisions/480-mch-key-order.md`. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #480`. No `CHANGELOG.md`, snapshot or golden changes.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main: already up to date, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `machine_key_order` | 2 passed |
| `machine_edit` | 12 passed |
| `machine_library` | 11 passed |
| `tormach_machines` | 5 passed |
| `camcraft-app --lib machine` | 5 passed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

UI tests were not run: no `crates/ui` files changed.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `order.items` is matched to array items by index. If an edit inserts or removes an array element, later elements may pick up a neighbour's key order. This only affects key order, never values, and is an acceptable limit for this fix.
- As the PR states, inline arrays still come out multi-line.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
